jobs.description:
Mechanical Design Engineer – Advanced Vehicle Concept Development
Employer: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Location: Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden
Employment Type: Full-time (100%)
Assignment Period: 12 October 2026 – 31 October 2028
Working Language: English (Swedish is considered an advantage but is not required.)

About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join an assignment with one of Sweden's leading automotive engineering teams in Södertälje.
The assignment focuses on advanced engineering and concept vehicle development, where new technologies within electrification, hydrogen, and e-Mining are explored and developed for future vehicle platforms.
You will work in a fast-paced research and development environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across R&D, Production, and other engineering stakeholders. The role requires a flexible and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working with concept development and evolving technical requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Contribute to concept development and early-phase mechanical design for advanced vehicle platforms.
Create and maintain 3D models and concept-level drawings using CATIA V5.
Develop technical solutions for cooling systems, braking systems, steering systems, and battery installations.
Support vehicle layout and packaging activities to ensure design feasibility.
Collaborate with R&D, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders throughout the development process.
Perform or support FEM calculations and design validation activities.
Participate in technical reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering solutions.
Deliver concept-level design solutions within project timelines while maintaining engineering quality.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 7 years of professional experience in mechanical design or a related engineering field.
Strong experience in concept development and early-stage product development within the automotive or heavy vehicle industry.
Proven hands-on experience with CATIA V5 (3D) for mechanical design and assemblies.
Good knowledge of ENOVIA or a similar Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.
Experience in designing and integrating Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) solutions.
Good understanding of vehicle layout, packaging, and system integration.
Experience with cooling systems, braking systems, steering systems, or battery components is highly meritorious.
Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) for design validation is an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment with changing project requirements.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Who You Are

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
We are recruiting a PhD student for a research project on regional exploration in Norrbotten, Sweden. Project is aiming to create a regional 3D geophysical model of the subsurface to guide mineral exploration and provide hints for possible deposits. Take the opportunity to study for a PhD in interdisciplinary, dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide.
Subject description
Applied Geophysics is a topic based on physical laws and practices, which combined with geological information can be used in a variety of applications. Geophysical research at the Division of Geosciences and Environmental Engineering includes both basic and applied research in exploration, environmental and engineering applications.
Project description
Rex project focuses on a full multi-scale geophysical prospecting for mineral exploration with added value of regional scale surveying for exploration targeting. Previous D-Rex project showed that by conducting geophysical surveys across regional-to-deposit scale it is possible to identify regional patterns, structures and anomalies that can be used to guide deposit-scale exploration.
Geophysical images transcending from continental- to deposit-scale can provide a better understanding of the geology of the region and how mineral deposits were formed and distributed. While allowing the identification of potential mineral deposits at a continental scale, and then focusing on specific areas for detailed exploration, they also lead to improved accuracy of mineral exploration by providing a more complete picture of the subsurface geology.
Duties
As a PhD student you are expected to perform both field work and theoretical work within your research studies as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. The majority of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies. You will work primarily with geophysical (magnetotelluric) data. 3D geophysical data modelling/inversion is a key focus of this PhD. You will work on development and extending our MR3Dmod modelling/inversion framework. In addition, you will have the opportunity to try the teacher role. As a PhD student, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects.
Qualifications
You must have academic credentials and recently completed your M.Sc or equivalent degree in geophysics, mathematics, physics, geology or other relevant subject. Good understanding of theory and numerical methods used in modelling and inversion is required. Experience in software development (Python in particular) and management of large data sets is important. You are expected to work in a team and are open to collaborate with colleagues and external partners. Fluent written and spoken English is required.
For further information about a specific research subject see; http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en
Most employees in the research subject exploration geophysics are currently men therefore provided that the qualifications are the same, the underrepresented gender will be given priority.
Further information
Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: July 2027.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in Waste Science and Technology
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Department for Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is looking for a Senior Lecturer, who is driven by the interest to strengthen their expertise in advanced environmental technologies, particularly in addressing persistent contaminants such as PFAS, PAH, antibiotics, pesticides.
 
 
This position is intended for advancing ongoing research of the group of Waste Science and Technology in waste management, circular material flows, waste detoxification, and environmental remediation, all of which are essential for driving progress toward a sustainable and environmentally responsible society. The Senior lecturer will contribute to the development of research and education efforts by studying and developing advanced treatment methods and integrated treatment chains for waste, contaminated soils and groundwater.
 
 
This recruitment aligns with the university’s vision to position itself among leaders in environmental technology and establish robust international research collaborations, leveraging unique research and education environment.
 
 
Subject description
 
Waste Science and Technology incorporates all stages of society’s waste management – generation, collection, treatment and disposal of waste, including reuse and recycling, as well as soil and groundwater remediation. The research aims at the development of tools and processes that facilitate sustainable soil remediation and waste management.
 
 
Duties
 
Your duties will mainly consist of research and education. You will lead research projects and supervise Master and PhD students. Teaching and educational development work is included in the tasks, as well as writing and submitting new project proposals for external funding. You will co-author scientific articles to be published in international peer-reviewed journals and present research results at national and international conferences. You are also expected to contribute to the research environment at the Department through participation in meetings, events and cooperation.
 
 
Qualifications 
 
To meet the requirements for the appointment as a senior lecturer, the applicants: 
must have been awarded a doctoral degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or adjacent areas or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree.
must demonstrate pedagogical expertise by means of proven experience, teaching expertise and teaching development.
must have completed higher education pedagogy courses equivalent to 7.5 higher education credits or otherwise have acquired equivalent knowledge.

Assessment criteria
 
The following assessment criteria apply to this position:
- scientific expertise
- pedagogical skills
- other assessment criteria
 
 
Other assessment criteria (Ranked in descending order):
- experience in sample preparation and analytical methods for contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) (e.g., PFAS and pharmaceuticals) in soil, waste, and water
- Experience in the development and/or application of advanced degradation technologies for CECs (e.g., electrochemical oxidation, sonolysis, and plasma-based technologies, etc.)
- the ability to obtain external research and development funding
- the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in English
- the ability to communicate research and development work orally and in writing
- the ability to collaborate with the wider community and stakeholders.
 
 
Information
 
The position is a permanent, full-time appointment at Luleå University of Technology.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Jurate Kumpiene, +46 920-493020, mailto:jurate.kumpiene@ltu.se

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan i Helsingborg söker nu en engagerad och relationsskapande kurator på 50%.

Internationella Engelska Skolan är en etablerad organisation med höga akademiska ambitioner och ett tydligt fokus på studiero, struktur och respekt. På IES arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en trygg och inspirerande miljö där både elever och medarbetare kan utvecklas och nå sin fulla potential.

Som kurator hos oss får du en central roll i att bidra till en trygg, strukturerad och inkluderande skolmiljö där elever ges bästa möjliga förutsättningar att nå sina kunskapsmål och utvecklas som individer.

 Vi söker dig som är trygg, tydlig och har en god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbete, har ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team. 

Du ingår i skolans elevhälsoteam (EHT), där vi arbetar nära tillsammans med ett tydligt fokus på förebyggande och hälsofrämjande insatser. Du samarbetar dagligen med skolledning, lärare och övrig personal för att skapa en positiv läromiljö präglad av studiero, tydlighet och höga förväntningar.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

- Genomföra individuella samtal med elever
- Arbeta med grupper och klasser i förebyggande syfte
- Bidra till skolans hälsofrämjande arbete
- Handleda och stötta personal i elevärenden
- Samverka med externa aktörer såsom BUP, socialtjänst och ungdomsmottagning
- Delta i nätverksmöten
- Arbeta aktivt med skolans plan mot kränkande behandling och diskriminering
- Ge stöd vid kris- och konfliktsituationer 

Kvalifikationer

- Socionomexamen eller annan relevant högskoleutbildning
- Erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar, gärna i skolmiljö
- God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska 

Vi erbjuder

- En tydlig organisation med starkt fokus på studiero och kvalitet
- Ett välfungerande elevhälsoteam
- Engagerade och professionella kollegor
- Möjlighet att bidra till skolans fortsatta utveckling

Rollen är tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning. Intervjuer sker löpande.

jobs.occupation: Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader
jobs.description:
Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Employment type: Contract / Full-time
Language: English
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader to join our client's team in Gothenburg.
In this assignment, you will play an important role in developing and improving the Quality Impression feature for Heavy Duty Vehicles. You will be responsible for defining requirements, evaluating feature status and supporting product development throughout different project phases.
You will also contribute to the long-term development of the feature by improving test methods, supporting simulation activities and contributing to roadmap planning.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an automotive or product development background who is interested in quality, design perception and vehicle engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Handle, define and coordinate requirements related to the Quality Impression feature.

Perform verification, evaluation and testing of models and physical products for Heavy Duty Vehicles.

Assess and monitor feature status throughout different project phases.

Provide technical feedback and collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product development teams.

Drive the development and continuous improvement of feature definitions, methods and processes.

Contribute to the long-term feature strategy and roadmap planning.

Support the development and improvement of test methods and simulation activities.

Prepare and communicate feature status reports to project stakeholders.

Represent the Quality Impression area in discussions and technical reviews.

Required Qualifications
Educational background in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development or a related technical field.

Experience in automotive engineering, industrial design or product development.

Understanding of product quality evaluation and development processes.

Experience in requirements handling, verification, evaluation or testing.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in Quality Impression or Perceived Quality.

Experience working with Heavy Duty Vehicles or the automotive industry.

Knowledge of CAE (Computer-Aided Engineering).

Experience with visualization techniques and 3D rendering.

Experience with simulation activities and product evaluation.

Experience in feature development, roadmap planning and cross-functional project work.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who is:
Curious, analytical and solution-oriented.

Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.

Confident in communicating technical topics and representing their area.

Collaborative, supportive and open-minded.

Able to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders.

Focused on continuous improvement and delivering high-quality results.

Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have experience in automotive product development, quality evaluation or feature engineering and would like to contribute to the development of Heavy Duty Vehicles, we would be happy to hear from you.
Please submit your updated CV along with a brief description of your relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Polish-Speaking babysitter / nanny in Sundbyberg – 2 afternoons per week
jobs.description:
Since 2008, Solidum Sverige AB / Barnakademin has helped families across Sweden find reliable, caring babysitters. We offer creative childcare in Swedish and specialize in bilingual babysitting, helping children develop their language skills naturally through play and everyday activities.
About the Position
We are looking for a caring, responsible, and enthusiastic Polish-speaking babysitter for a family in Sundbyberg, with two children aged 3 and 6.
The family needs regular help 2 afternoons per week, from 15:00 to 18:00 (6 hours per week). The role involves picking up the children from preschool/school, bringing them home safely, and spending the afternoon together until their parents return.
The family would like their children to maintain and develop their Polish language skills, so we are looking for someone who enjoys speaking Polish with children and making the language a natural part of everyday activities.
Your responsibilities will include:
Picking up the children from preschool/school and accompanying them home safely
Organizing fun, creative, and age-appropriate activities
Playing, reading, singing, and communicating with the children in Polish
Helping with simple afternoon routines and snacks
Creating a warm, safe, and positive environment for the children

Who We're Looking For
We would love to hear from you if you:
Speak Polish at a native or fluent level
Communicate confidently in English or Swedish
Have previous experience caring for children, professionally or privately
Are responsible, reliable, patient, and genuinely enjoy spending time with children
Enjoy creative play, outdoor activities, and engaging children in learning
Are available 2 weekdays per week, from 15:00 to 18:00
Can commit to the position until at least summer 2027

This position is particularly suitable for university students or anyone looking for a rewarding part-time job alongside their studies or other commitments.
What We Offer
A regular part-time position with a family in Sundbyberg
A supportive and friendly working environment
Ongoing guidance and support from our central office
A welcoming community of fellow babysitters
Written references at the end of your employment
Opportunities for additional babysitting assignments with other families
Valuable experience working with children in a bilingual environment

Available Only One Afternoon per Week?
We still encourage you to apply! Even if you cannot commit to both afternoons, we may have other families looking for Polish-speaking babysitters whose schedules match your availability.
Apply Today!
If you love working with children and would enjoy helping them grow up with the Polish language, we would be happy to hear from you!
Please submit your application in English or Swedish, including a brief description of your childcare experience, language skills, and availability.
We look forward to welcoming you to Barnakademin!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:

Vi ser att du har:

- God kunskap om skolans styrdokument och relevant skollagstiftning.
- Erfarenhet eller god kunskap om elevhälsoarbete och förebyggande insatser.
- Förståelse för arbetet med trygghet, studiero och kränkande behandling.

- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

- Möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i elevernas vardag och skolgång.

Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till recruitment.varmdo@engelska.se.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta maria.segerstedt.varmdo@engelska.se.
